project_title: Will you love me forever? — Editorial Romantic Proposal & Microsite
app_type: immersive single-page romantic experience / proposal microsite (frontend-only)
emotional_archetype: Organic & Earthy / Velvet Romance Fusion (Love letter couture meets Swiss typography & playful micro-physics)
design_principles: Fusion over imitation: Mixing classic vintage epistolary romance with Swiss editorial precision and kinetic playful web motion
Emotion first: Every scroll state, heart flutter, dodge interaction, and sound chime maps directly to vulnerability, warmth, and lifelong commitment
Content is king: Narrative unfolds like a 4-act intimate film — The Prologue, The Manifesto Chapters, The Slow Ribbon of Vows, and The Big Question
Zoom in & intimate tactile details: Wax seal motifs, warm paper textures, vintage postal stamps, subtle WebAudio celesta chimes, and micro-particle physics
Tactile tension: The playful evasive 'No' button creating lighthearted suspense until the euphoric golden confetti celebration on 'Yes'

playful_no_button.behavior: When cursor enters within 85px threshold or triggers onMouseEnter / onTouchStart, the button calculates opposite vector and animates with framer-motion spring to a random safe offset within boundary limits
playful_no_button.fallback_click: If somehow clicked, pops up playful alert playfully redirecting to Yes

yes_button_celebration.behavior: Click triggers instant celebratory multi-phase sequence: 1) Massive full-screen golden & rose confetti cannon burst 2) Floating heart explosion 3) WebAudio plays romantic triumphant chime melody 4) Expands celebration modal with customizable couple letter, countdown to 'Day 1 of Forever', and a download/share certificate.

names_personalization.mechanism: Header badge & floating pencil button allows opening a sleek micro-dialog to type custom names (stored in localStorage or state), immediately dynamically updating all manifesto chapters, hero greeting, and proposal card.

webaudio_music_box.implementation: Native WebAudio oscillator with soft bell/sine envelopes, lowpass filter, and gentle reverb effect playing a repeating 16-note romantic arpeggio (Canon in D / Gymnopedie inspired). Fully zero latency, no network asset delay, user-gesture unlocked on first interaction.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts in public/index.html or @import in index.css: Cormorant Garamond, Playfair Display, and Quicksand.

Implement the full single-page experience in React .js files (no .tsx). Keep components modular inside src/components/ (e.g. FloatingHeartsCanvas.js, ConfettiBurst.js, AudioMusicBox.js, ProposalCard.js, ManifestoGrid.js, NamesConfigModal.js).
Use Framer Motion for scroll-reveals, staggered line reveals in hero, and the dodging physics of the No button.
Ensure contrast requirements are strictly met: Deep plum (#5c2a3b) on cream background (#fff6f2) provides > 10:1 contrast ratio, ensuring flawless APCA and WCAG compliance.
Ensure the No button has bounded movement so it remains within viewport or proposal container bounds and doesn't get clipped offscreen.
Add all required data-testid attributes to all interactive elements as defined in testing_attributes.
Keep WebAudio synth completely client-side with an easy toggle button in the header and initial muted state until user toggles or interacts.
